comparison.method: Git blob SHA comparison by relative path against the exact recorded upstream template commit

interpretation.byteIdenticalFiles: These seven files have identical Git blob content at the compared relative paths.
interpretation.modifiedFiles: Different content at the same path; this comparison does not distinguish permitted configuration/customization from upstream source modification.
interpretation.localOnlyFiles: Not present at the compared upstream paths; these may be LuckRead-owned code, separately reused upstream material, assets, or generated files. Each copied/adapted source still requires its own provenance and license record.
interpretation.upstreamOnlyFiles: Files present in the upstream template but absent at the same W01 relative path; omission alone is not evidence of a violation.
interpretation.limitation: This is a path-and-blob comparison against one historical template snapshot, not a complete semantic source audit or proof that all local-only code is original.
